title: Louvres
description: A wall of tall reeded-glass louvres standing in front of a mountain valley. Drag across them and the blades turn on their pivots in a heavy, coupled wave that re-slices the view and throws moving caustics across the pale floor.
intent: One architectural material finished to the edge: real fluted glass blades with thickness, refraction, dispersion and a key-light glint, hung on a weighted torsion chain your hand runs along.
